planting.before_window_one: Planting {{count}} day before the window opens ({{window_start}}); cold soil and frost risk.
planting.before_window_other: Planting {{count}} days before the window opens ({{window_start}}); cold soil and frost risk.
planting.past_optimal: Past the optimal window ({{window_end}}); expect a yield penalty.
planting.harvest_too_late: Projected harvest {{harvest}} is after the harvest-by date {{harvest_by}}; choose an earlier variety or plant sooner.
planting.harvest_after_season: Harvest {{harvest}} falls after the season ends {{season_end}}.
planting.previous_crop_in_ground: {{crop}} is still in the ground until {{harvest_date}}.

crop.high_water_dryland: High-water crop on a dryland field; consider a drought-tolerant variety or irrigation.

rotation.continuous_cropping: {{crop}} follows {{crop}}; continuous cropping builds pest and disease pressure.
rotation.legume_credit: Legume credit: {{previous}} before {{crop}} offsets nitrogen demand.
rotation.same_root_depth: Consecutive crops share rooting depth; alternate deep and shallow to use the profile.
rotation.too_frequent_one: {{crop}} appeared once in the last {{seasons}} seasons.
rotation.too_frequent_other: {{crop}} appeared {{count}} times in the last {{seasons}} seasons.
rotation.no_legume: No nitrogen-fixing crop in the cycle; expect higher N inputs.

monoculture.label: Monoculture
monoculture.hint: One crop on the whole field.

intercrop.label: Intercrop
intercrop.hint: Two or more crops grown together in the same rows or alternating rows.

relay.label: Relay
relay.hint: Second crop sown into the first before it is harvested.

strip.label: Strip
strip.hint: Alternating strips wide enough for separate machinery passes.

cover.label: Cover crop
cover.hint: Non-cash crop grown to protect and build soil.

constraints.noneApply: No resource constraints apply to this farm and season.
constraints.title: Resource constraints
constraints.subtitle: Water, labor, nitrogen, budget, and acreage limits that plans and strategies are checked against.
constraints.pickSeason: Pick a season in the scope control to see utilisation.
constraints.orgWideOnly: Only organization-wide limits apply across all farms. Pick a farm in the scope control to check farm-specific constraints.
constraints.emptyBody: Add an irrigation allocation, a labor ceiling, or a season budget. Hard limits block adoption; soft ones warn.
constraints.hardHint: Hard limit — strategies that exceed it are infeasible and cannot be adopted without override
constraints.deleteBody: Strategies will be re-evaluated without it the next time they are opened.

strategies.title: Farming strategies
strategies.subtitle: Alternative plans for a farm-season, scored on margin, resources, rotation, and risk. Compare, then adopt one.
strategies.emptyBody: Create one from scratch, or open a rotation and generate next season's allocations from it.
strategies.baselineTooltip: Baseline — comparisons show deltas against this

plans.title: Crop plans
plans.subtitle: What is planted where, with window fit, mixed-cropping components, and provenance.
plans.emptyBody: Create a plan directly, or build a strategy and adopt it to generate plans for every field.

rotations.title: Rotations
rotations.subtitle: Multi-year crop sequences with cover crops and companions, assigned to fields and staggered by phase.
rotations.emptyBody: Build a multi-year cycle, add a cover crop, then assign fields.
rotations.yearHint: Anchors the cycle to the calendar; fields can be phase-shifted

budget.title: Seasonal budget
budget.subtitle: Planned versus actual spend by input category.
budget.emptyBody: Add seed, fertilizer, chemical, and custom hire lines for this season.

catalog.intro: Agronomic profile and default economics per crop. Strategies and the variety recommender read these.
catalog.emptyBody: Add your first crop to start planning.

fields.familyHint: Drives rotation rules, e.g. Poaceae, Fabaceae, Solanaceae
fields.intercropsHint: Highlighted when building a mixed-cropping plan
fields.soilsHint: Leave empty if the variety suits any soil
fields.harvestByHint: First killing frost or contract date

catalog.deleteCropBody: Varieties and planting windows for this crop are removed too. Crops referenced by plans cannot be deleted.
catalog.varietiesEmptyBody: Add hybrids with maturity, drought tolerance, and soil suitability so the recommender can rank them.
catalog.deleteVarietyBody: Plans that reference this variety keep their crop but lose the variety.
catalog.noVarieties: No varieties defined for this crop
catalog.windowsIntro: Optimal and late sowing dates plus a harvest-by deadline. Variety- or farm-specific rows override the crop-wide one.
catalog.windowsEmptyBody: Without windows the planner falls back to generic dates by crop category.
catalog.deleteWindowBody: Assessments fall back to the next most specific window, or the category default.
catalog.pageSubtitle: Species, varieties, and planting windows that drive planning, recommendations, and strategy economics.
